verses.sloka: हते तु लवणे देवाः सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः ।ऊचुः सुमधुरां वाणीं शत्रुघ्नं शत्रुतापनम् ।। ७.७०.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: hate tu lavaṇe devāḥ sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ ।ūcuḥ sumadhurāṁ vāṇīṁ śatrughnaṁ śatrutāpanam ।। 7.70.1 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, after Lavana was killed, the gods, led by Indra and with Agni at their forefront, spoke very sweet words to Shatrughna, the tormentor of enemies.

verses.sloka: दिष्ट्या ते विजयो वत्स दिष्ट्या लवणराक्षसः ।हतः पुरुषशार्दूल वरं वरय सुव्रत ।। ७.७०.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā te vijayo vatsa diṣṭyā lavaṇarākṣasaḥ ।hataḥ puruṣaśārdūla varaṁ varaya suvrata ।। 7.70.2 ॥

translations.english: O dear and virtuous tiger among men, it is by good fortune that you have achieved victory and the demon Lavana has been killed; now, ask for a boon.
translations.hindi: हे राजशादूल ! यह विदेहराज की पुरातन कथा जिसमें वसिष्ठ सुनि जी की कथा का भी प्रसङ्ग दै, अत्यन्त विस्मयकारिण्णी है

verses.sloka: वरदास्तु महाबाहो सर्व एव समागताः ।विजयाकाङ्क्षिणस्तुभ्यममोघं दर्शनं हि नः ।। ७.७०.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: varadāstu mahābāho sarva eva samāgatāḥ ।vijayākāṅkṣiṇastubhyamamoghaṁ darśanaṁ hi naḥ ।। 7.70.3 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed one, all of us who have assembled here are indeed givers of boons, having desired your victory, and our presence here is certainly not in vain.
translations.hindi: i oe Me # पाठान्तरे-~“निवृत्तं |” † पाठान्तरे ~ चष्मा । परन्तु में पूछता हूँ रि, राजा निमि तो क्षत्रिय, शूरवीर और विशेष कर, उस समय यज्ञदीक्षा लिए हुए थे । उन्होने महर्षि वसिष्ठ को क्षमा करों नहीं किया ?

verses.sloka: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा शूरो मूर्ध्नि कृताञ्जलिः ।प्रत्युवाच महाबाहुः शत्रुघ्नः प्रयतात्मवान् ।। ७.७०.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: devānāṁ bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā śūro mūrdhni kṛtāñjaliḥ ।pratyuvāca mahābāhuḥ śatrughnaḥ prayatātmavān ।। 7.70.4 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of the gods, the brave, mighty-armed, and self-controlled Shatrughna, with folded hands placed on his head, replied.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--धर्मानुष्ठान में दीक्षा लिए हुए को क्रोध करना वर्जित हे । क्योंकि क्रोध करने से धर्मानुष्ठान नष्ट हो जाता है । ] एवमुक्तस्तु तेनायं #रामः क्षत्रियपुङ्ग्रः उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्य सवशा्रविशारदम्‌

verses.sloka: इयं मधुपुरी रस्या मधुरा देवनिर्मिता ।निवेशं प्राप्नुयाच्छीघ्रमेष मे ऽस्तु वरः परः ।। ७.७०.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: iyaṁ madhupurī rasyā madhurā devanirmitā ।niveśaṁ prāpnuyācchīghrameṣa me 'stu varaḥ paraḥ ।। 7.70.5 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna requested that this delightful and sweet city of Madhu, which was created by the gods, quickly become a populated settlement, declaring this to be his foremost boon.

verses.sloka: तं देवाः प्रीतमनसो बाढमित्येव राघवम् ।भविष्यति पुरी रम्या शूरसेना न संशयः ।। ७.७०.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ devāḥ prītamanaso bāḍhamityeva rāghavam ।bhaviṣyati purī ramyā śūrasenā na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.70.6 ॥

translations.english: With pleased minds, the gods replied to Shatrughna, the descendant of Raghu, saying "So be it," and assured him that the city would indeed become a beautiful one in the region of Shurasena, without a doubt.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! क्रोध बड़ा दुस्सह होता है । देखो सतोगणी राजा ययाति ते अपने क्राध को उभरने नहीं दिया था। उस कथा को में कहता हूँ, तुम मन लगा कर सुनो

verses.sloka: ते तथोक्त्वा महात्मानो दिवमारुरुहुस्तदा ।शत्रुघ्नो ऽपि महातेजास्तां सेनां समुपानयत् ।। ७.७०.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: te tathoktvā mahātmāno divamāruruhustadā ।śatrughno 'pi mahātejāstāṁ senāṁ samupānayat ।। 7.70.7 ॥

translations.english: After the great sages spoke, they ascended to the heavens, and then the powerful Shatrughna gathered that army.
translations.hindi: राजा ययाति महाराज नहुष के पुत्र थे । वे प्रजा का पालन करने और प्रज्ञाजञनों की सुखसम्पत्ति बढ़ाने में सदा तत्पर रहा # पाठान्तरे श्रीमान्‌ ।” करते थे । हे लक्ष्मण ! इस भूमण्डल पर सब से अधिक रूपबतीः , उनकी पत्नियाँ थीं

verses.sloka: सा सेना शीघ्रमागच्छच्छ्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नशासनम् ।निवेशनं च शत्रुघ्नः श्रावणेन समारभत् ।। ७.७०.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā senā śīghramāgacchacchrutvā śatrughnaśāsanam ।niveśanaṁ ca śatrughnaḥ śrāvaṇena samārabhat ।। 7.70.8 ॥

translations.english: That army quickly arrived upon hearing Shatrughna's command, and Shatrughna began the establishment of the city in the month of Shravana.

verses.sloka: सा पुरा दिव्यसङ्काशा वर्षे द्वादशमे शुभे ।निविष्टा शूरसेनानां विषयश्चाकुतोभयः ।। ७.७०.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā purā divyasaṅkāśā varṣe dvādaśame śubhe ।niviṣṭā śūrasenānāṁ viṣayaścākutobhayaḥ ।। 7.70.9 ॥

translations.english: That city, resembling a divine abode, was established in the auspicious twelfth year, becoming a region for brave warriors, free from all fear.

verses.sloka: क्षेत्राणि सस्ययुक्तानि काले वर्षति वासवः ।अरोगवीरपुरुषा शत्रुघ्नभुजपालिता ।। ७.७०.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣetrāṇi sasyayuktāni kāle varṣati vāsavaḥ ।arogavīrapuruṣā śatrughnabhujapālitā ।। 7.70.10 ॥

translations.english: The fields were full of crops, Indra rained at the proper time, and the region, protected by Shatrughna's arm, had healthy and brave men.
translations.hindi: उन दोनों के रूपवान दो पुत्र हुए। शर्मिष्ठा के गर्भ से प्रु आर देवयानी के गर्भ से यदु का जन्म हुआ

translations.english: The city, resembling a half-moon and beautified by the Yamuna's banks, was adorned with grand houses, squares, shops, and streets, inhabited by people of all four varnas, and bustling with diverse commerce.
translations.hindi: माता के समान गुणवान्‌ होने क॑ कारण राजा का अपने राज्ञ कुमार -पूरु पर विशेष स्नेह था. । यह देख, बहुत दुःखो हो दूसरे राजकुमार यदु ने अपनी माता से कहा

verses.sloka: यच्च तेन पुरा शुभ्रं लवणेन कृतं महत् ।तच्छोभयति शत्रुघ्नो नानावर्णोपशोभिताम् ।। ७.७०.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: yacca tena purā śubhraṁ lavaṇena kṛtaṁ mahat ।tacchobhayati śatrughno nānāvarṇopaśobhitām ।। 7.70.12 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna now beautifies that great and pure city, which was formerly created by Lavana, adorning it with various colors.
translations.hindi: भार्गवस्य कुले जाता देवस्याक्रिषएकमणः । सहसे हृद्गतं दुःखमवमानं च दुःसहम्‌

verses.sloka: आरामैश्च विहारैश्च शोभमानं समन्ततः ।शोभितां शोभनीयैश्च तथा ऽन्यैर्दैवमानुषैः ।। ७.७०.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: ārāmaiśca vihāraiśca śobhamānaṁ samantataḥ ।śobhitāṁ śobhanīyaiśca tathā 'nyairdaivamānuṣaiḥ ।। 7.70.13 ॥

translations.english: The city was adorned all around with gardens and pleasure-grounds, and beautified by other divine and human elements.
That city, resembling a divine abode, was adorned with various merchandise and beautified by merchants who had arrived from diverse lands.
translations.hindi: ओर यदि तुमको यह क्लेश और अगमान "सहना पसन्द हो सो तू सह । किन्तु मुझे आज्ञा दे। क्योंकि मुझसे तो यह नहीं सहा जाता। में तो निस्सन्देह अपने प्राण दे दूँगा

verses.sloka: तां समृद्धां समृद्धार्थः शत्रुघ्नो भरतानुजः ।निरीक्ष्य परमप्रीतः परं हर्षमुपागमत् ।। ७.७०.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ samṛddhāṁ samṛddhārthaḥ śatrughno bharatānujaḥ ।nirīkṣya paramaprītaḥ paraṁ harṣamupāgamat ।। 7.70.15 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna, the younger brother of Bharata, whose purpose was fulfilled, observed that prosperous city and attained supreme joy, being extremely pleased.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार परम दुःखी एवं रोते हुए पुत्र के बचन सुन कर, देवयानी क्रुद्ध हो, ध्यान द्वारा अपने पिता को स्मरण करने लगी

verses.sloka: तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना निवेश्य मधुरां पुरीम् ।रामपादौ निरीक्षे ऽहं वर्षे द्वादश आगते ।। ७.७०.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā niveśya madhurāṁ purīm ।rāmapādau nirīkṣe 'haṁ varṣe dvādaśa āgate ।। 7.70.16 ॥

translations.english: A thought arose in his mind that after establishing the city of Mathura, he would go to see Rama's feet when the twelfth year arrived.
translations.hindi: इङ्गित तदभिज्ञाय दुहितुर्भाग स्तदा । आगतस्त्वरितं तत्र देवयानी स्म यत्र सा ।!१६॥ अपनी बेटी को दुःखी ओर कुपित जान, उसके स्मरण करते डी, शुक्र महराज वहाँ पहुँचे, जहां उनकी बेटी थी

verses.sloka: ततः स ताममरपुरोपमां पुरीं निवेश्य वै विविधजनाभिसंवृताम् ।नराधिपो रघुपतिपाददर्शने दधे मतिं रघुकुलवंशवर्धनः ।। ७.७०.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa tāmamarapuropamāṁ purīṁ niveśya vai vividhajanābhisaṁvṛtām ।narādhipo raghupatipādadarśane dadhe matiṁ raghukulavaṁśavardhanaḥ ।। 7.70.17 ।।

translations.english: After establishing that city, which resembled the city of gods and was filled with various people, the king Shatrughna, the enhancer of the Raghu lineage, set his mind on seeing the feet of Lord Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 70 ।। Thus ends the seventieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: देवयानी को अस्वस्थ, दुःखी और छुब्ध देख कर, शुक्र जी अपनी बेटी से बोले-बेटी ! तेरी यह. क्या दशा है ?
